record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace final-state readout with causal exponential pooling of nonpadding GRU states using weights proportional to 0.8^(t-j) for j<=t, normalized over real positions. Apply the same pooling at every supervised training position and at the final real inference position. This may retain recent complementary interests while reducing dependence on the latest interaction. Preserve history truncation, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer; update the predictor writer consistently.

Apply identical pooling at every supervised training position and the final real inference position across all four categories.
